cases.question: What regulatory risks do the major pharmaceutical companies face, and how are they addressing them?

missed.fact: AbbVie says the Inflation Reduction Act will reduce prices and reimbursements for certain of its products.
Johnson & Johnson says the Inflation Reduction Act has subjected certain of its products to government-established pricing beginning in 2026.
Johnson & Johnson's Janssen unit filed litigation in July 2023 challenging the constitutionality of the IRA's Medicare Drug Price Negotiation Program.
Eli Lilly announced preliminary voluntary agreements with the U.S. government in November 2025 under which it agreed to lower Medicaid and certain other drug prices for U.S. patients.
Merck expects U.S. sales of Keytruda to decline beginning in January 2028 when government pricing under the Inflation Reduction Act takes effect.
Merck has sued the U.S. government over the IRA's Drug Price Negotiation Program.
Pfizer says changes in U.S. and international regulations that mandate price controls could adversely affect its future results.
Pfizer says it has engaged with major payors and the U.S. government to explore opportunities to improve access and reimbursement.
